BatPathIntelliSense.description: File and directory path completion for Windows .bat / .cmd files. Typing .\ ..\ C:\ or \\server\share\ pops up a candidate list, inserts a trailing backslash for directories, and drills into the next level. Ported from the VS Code extension bat-path-intellisense.
BatPathIntelliSense.author: nicehero

BetterMultiSelection.description: Provides better cursor movements when using multiple selections.
BetterMultiSelection.author: Justin Dailey

BigFiles.description:
Reads very large files. It does this by only showing a small buffer of the file and let the user move back anf forth in the page.
This is useful when you want to preview very large text files. Opening is done separately from Notepad++ and there is no option to save.
https://github.com/superolmo/BigFiles
BigFiles.author: Claudio Olmi

BlitzSearch.description:
Adds Blitz Search This to the Toolbar. Features:
- Search This command with selection to run Blitz Search with substring
- Search This command with no selection to run Blitz Search with Whole word match
BlitzSearch.author: NateStah

ColumnTools.description: Notepad++ Highlight Current Column and Horizontal Ruler
ColumnTools.author: Vin's World

CommentToggler.description:
Smart single button comment toggler. Features:
- Does not insert space in front of the comment
- Supports all the built-in languages and even user defined languages
- Can do simple single line comments without selection
- Preserves indentation in the commented code block
- Fixes some indentation inconsistencies
- Supports block comments
- Supports multiple selections
- With every type of comment at the same time!
CommentToggler.author: ScienceDiscoverer

Compose.description: Implements a Compose key for entering characters not available on the keyboard with easily remembered key sequences.
Compose.author: Randall Joseph Fellmy

dark_mode_C.description: Adds toolbar icons to instantly switch between light and dark mode with no restart required. Features an automatic mode that dynamically toggles your theme based on local sunrise and sunset times.
dark_mode_C.author: pullitall

DualScrollbars.description: A simple Notepad++ plugin that adds a second vertical scrollbar with mirrored line numbers and markers.
DualScrollbars.author: SaiyajinK

EmojiDescription.description: Displays detailed character encoding information in the status bar: Unicode code point, character name, HTML entity, and the UTF-8 byte sequence in hexadecimal, decimal or git-style octal notation. A menu command opens a dialog with every field for the character at the caret, ready to copy to the clipboard. Works for any character including emoji.
EmojiDescription.author: Ruberoid

FileTools.description:
Tidy, validate and convert YAML, JSON and CSV directly in Notepad++.
Features:
- Reindent / tidy YAML (comments preserved)
- Full conversion matrix: YAML, JSON, CSV and Parquet (via duckdb.exe) all reach each other
- JSON: pretty-print, minify, sort keys, escape/unescape
- CSV: align, compact, delimiter convert, sort, transpose, add/remove quotes
- Settings dialog with saved profiles
FileTools.author: Datamodder

FixParser.description: Pretty-print and inspect FIX protocol logs: field/value decoding, hover quickview, and a dockable message inspector.
FixParser.author: Chris Taylor

FoldingLineHider.description: This Notepad++ plugin can hide the unsightly folding lines, and for convenience, you can fold and unfold the current level using the Alt + Left/Right keys.
FoldingLineHider.author: leonardchai@gmail.com

FormatSQL.description:
Formats, minifies and converts SQL directly in Notepad++.
Features:
- Format / minify SQL, format-on-save, format-and-copy
- Multi-dialect conversion (ANSI, Snowflake, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Databricks)
- Quote, comment-style, boolean and number-format conversion
- Configurable casing, alignment, structure and spacing rules with saved profiles
FormatSQL.author: Datamodder

FWDataViz.description: Fixed Width Data Visualizer adds Excel-like features for fixed-width data files in Notepad++. Displays cursor position data. Foldable Record Blocks; Hop & Jump to specific fields. Field Copy & Field Paste. Data Extraction. Builtin dialogs to configure file-type, record-type & fields; and themes & colors. Automatic File Type Detection. Handles homogenous, mixed & multi-line records. Full Multi-byte character support. Darkmode enabled.
FWDataViz.author: Shridhar Kumar

GitSCM.description: N++ Gui for already installed Git SCM for Windows. Optionally TortoiseGit.
GitSCM.author: Michael J. Vincent

GotoLineCol.description: A plugin to navigate to a specified line and (byte-based or character-based) column position. Will also display character byte code, UTF-8 byte sequence & Unicode code point, name & block at cursor position. Darkmode enabled. Command line options.
GotoLineCol.author: Shridhar Kumar

HexEditor.description: Hex editor. Some reported issues, however many bugs fixed in latest release.
HexEditor.author: Jens Lorenz

HLASMLexer.description: Column-aware syntax highlighting for IBM HLASM. Understands the 80-column punch card layout — labels, operations, operands, continuation markers and sequence numbers are each highlighted by their column position, not just keywords.
HLASMLexer.author: Zane Hambly

HTMLTag.description:
Provides three core functions:
- HTML and XML tag jumping, like the built-in brace matching and selection
 of tags and/or contents.
- HTML entity encoding/decoding (example: é to é)
- JS character encoding/decoding (example: é to \u00E9)
HTMLTag.author: Martijn Coppoolse

IndentByFold.description:
Indent using Fold points
Note: Disable Notepad++'s Auto Indent in Settings - Preferences - MISC - Untick Auto Indent.
IndentByFold.author: Ben Bluemel, Frank Fesevur

Language_Selector.description:
Set the programming language and see the syntax highlighting on new files without the need to save them, or to go each time to the menu to choose the language.
You can also pin your favourite languages for quick access.
Language_Selector.author: Abdellah Hassaine

LuaScript.description: Adds Lua scripting capabilities. This provides control over all of Scintilla's features and options with a light-weight, fully-functional programming language.
LuaScript.author: Justin Dailey

MarkdownTableEditor.description: Edits Markdown pipe tables as aligned text. Align, fit width, narrow or widen columns, navigate, insert, delete, move and sort rows or columns, convert CSV/TSV blocks, and insert new tables from Notepad++.
MarkdownTableEditor.author: Kreout

mimeTools.description: Implements several main functionalities defined in MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions): Base64, Quoted-printable and URL encode/decode
mimeTools.author: Don HO

MultiReplace.description: Multi-pattern search & replace across single or multiple files; reusable search & replace lists; CSV column operations (sort, delete, deduplicate); FlowTabs for visual column alignment; dockable search results; rectangular selection support; Lua/ExprTk formula engine with conditional and math logic.
MultiReplace.author: Thomas Knoefel

MZC8051.description: a 8051 c compiler plugin within notepad++.
MZC8051.author: Jiangshan00001

NestedDSV.description: Plugin for visualizing hierarchical (nested) delimiter-separated values (DSV) data in Notepad++. Displays cursor position data. Jumps to specific fields. Folding Record Blocks. Extracts Data. Builtin dialogs to configure file-type, record-type & fields; Themes & Colors; and Folding.
NestedDSV.author: Shridhar Kumar

nppAutoDetectIndent.description: Detects indention (tab or spaces) and auto adjust Tab key on-the-fly.
nppAutoDetectIndent.author: Mike Tzou (Chocobo1)

NppBplistPlugin.description: Supports viewing/editing binary plist files. Due to the fact that ordinary plist files have XML format, this plugin does not support them. It only loads binary plist files (bplist).
NppBplistPlugin.author: Sergiy Azarovsky

NppCrossCheck.description:
Compare two lists in the current document.
Place the two lists separated by one or more blank lines and run the plugin to cross-check their contents.
NppCrossCheck.author: Pablo Lopez

NppEditorConfig.description: EditorConfig is a text file that defines coding conventions for a project to help maintain them consistent no matter which text editor you use. This plugin adds support for .editorconfig files to Notepad++. It will automatically discover and apply matching .editorconfig settings to the files that you open for editing. For the EditorConfig recommended use, file format and samples, visit https://editorconfig.org/.
NppEditorConfig.author: EditorConfig Team

NppExec.description: Execute commands or saved scripts without leaving Notepad++.
NppExec.author: Vitaliy Dovgan

NppExport.description: True WYSIWYG exporter. Allows you not only to save your source code as an HTML/RTF file, but also to copy your source code in the clipboard in RTF/HTML format, so you can paste it into your word processor (Openoffice.org Writer, LibreOffice Writer, Abiword, MS Word) to get the same visual effect.

NppFavorites.description:
Favorites plugin.
Notepad++ does not come with favorites. This is a simple solution to that problem.
NppFavorites.author: Helder Sepulveda

NppFoldTail.description: A Notepad++ plugin for cleaner, more readable code folding.
NppFoldTail.author: Sean Lin

NppJavaPlugin.description: Allows Java Code Compilation and Execution directly from Notepad++.
NppJavaPlugin.author: Dominik Cebula

NppLdapFormatter.description: Validate and format LDAP filters as readable multiline expressions or compact single-line expressions. Preserves the original text on errors and supports atomic undo.
NppLdapFormatter.author: Ignacio Javier Julio Posada

NppMenuScripts.description: Lets you create custom script menus and run JavaScript, Perl, and Python scripts from Notepad++.
NppMenuScripts.author: Sean Lin

nppplugin_ofis2.description: Lets you index specific folders and possible specific types of resources (XML, CPP, PY files) for a fast indexing of files.
nppplugin_ofis2.author: IncredibleJunior

nppplugin_solutionhub.description: Base requirement for several plugins from incfred.
nppplugin_solutionhub.author: IncredibleJunior

nppplugin_solutionhub_ui.description: Basic UI to create and setup solutions used by the SolutionHub.
nppplugin_solutionhub_ui.author: IncredibleJunior

nppplugin_solutiontools.description:
Configurable priority-based fileswitching (most commonly used when switching between .h and .cpp). Configurable what extensions map to which targets and in what order.
'goto file' implementation, Ex. stand on a line, press whatever shortcut(or left mouseclick on the line) you have bound to the GOTO command on a line like :
#include "somefile.h"
or
require 'some_path/to_a_luafile'
nppplugin_solutiontools.author: IncredibleJunior

NppPluginDemo.description: Notepad++ Plugin Demo is written from Notepad++ Plugin Template to demonstrate the usage of plugin API.
NppPluginDemo.author: Don HO

NppPluginOpenHost.description: Allow to open Host file on Windows
NppPluginOpenHost.author: jejemorg

NppPluginTemplate.description: Template for making plugin development as easy and simple as possible. Four steps and it's done.
NppPluginTemplate.author: Don HO

NppRestoreCursorPosition.description: Remember the caret position of a closed file and restore it the next time that file is opened.
NppRestoreCursorPosition.author: RivieraSystems

NppRgaIsaPlugin.description: A plugin that displays the assembler ISA code of a compiled HLSL shader in a separate dockable panel. Compilation is performed via rga.exe (Radeon GPU Analyzer) in DX12 mode directly to ISA (without intermediate SPIR-V).
NppRgaIsaPlugin.author: Dmitry Budik

NppSnippets.description: Adds the possibility to add code snippets to the current document by selecting them from a simple list.
NppSnippets.author: Frank Fesevur

NppStripIpAndHost.description: Strips out sensitive IP addresses (IPv4 & IPv6) and hostnames from text files and server logs. Features a custom replacement UI and safe per-document undo.
NppStripIpAndHost.author: Tomas Larsson

NppTags.description: NppTags is a Universal Ctags plug-in to browse through your sources easily and lets you jump to a selected function / variable / class / etc in your code by pressing just one key.
NppTags.author: Frank Fesevur

NppTaskList.description: Automatically scans the open document and adds all "TODO:*" items to your task list, a window pane docked on the right. Double-clicking an item in the list will take you to that line in the code.
NppTaskList.author: blitowitz

NppTextFX.description: TextFX2 is a Notepad++ plugin which performs a variety of common conversions on selected text.
NppTextFX.author: Karlheinz Graf

NppVim.description: A Notepad++ plugin that adds Vim-style editing and key bindings.
NppVim.author: h-jangra

NppZenHankaku.description: Convert between full-width (zenkaku) and half-width (hankaku) characters: alphanumerics, katakana, symbols, and spaces. Supports multiple and rectangular selections.
NppZenHankaku.author: RivieraSystems

NX_ASCII_Database_Helper.description: This is a Notepad++ plugin for Siemens NX CAM ASCII Database file, which help the user list all of type in database and format file.
NX_ASCII_Database_Helper.author: Xuefeng

OCamlLexer.description: Syntax highlighting, folding and live linting for OCaml. A Scintilla ILexer5 lexer, so OCaml registers as a real language, with nested comments, quoted strings and char literals kept apart from type variables. Bundles the olint linter, which draws diagnostics inline on open and save.
OCamlLexer.author: Zane Hambly

Papyrus.description: View and edit Papyrus Script files used by Bethesda games with syntax highlighting, function and block folding, hyperlinks to referenced scripts, keywords matching, plus compilation support with anonymized output and error list view.
Papyrus.author: blu3mania

pork2sausage.description: Pass any selected text to any command line program as input and take the output (the result of program) to replace the selected text.
pork2sausage.author: Don HO

qkNppReverseLines.description: Reverse lines in the selection or document. It works like the unix tac command.
qkNppReverseLines.author: Query Kuma

QueryFiles.description:
Run SQL on CSV, Parquet, JSON and Excel files directly in Notepad++, powered by DuckDB (duckdb.exe).
Features:
- Query this file: the open data file becomes THIS in a new SQL tab
- Join files on disk: from 'orders.parquet' join 'customers.csv' ...
- Results as text in a tab, or as a sortable table in a docked panel
- Describe / Summarize THIS, toolbar button, cancel and timeout
QueryFiles.author: Datamodder

QuickText.description: Quick text substitution, including multi-field inputs. Similar to Tab Triggers in TextMate.
QuickText.author: Joao Moreno, Jing Teng

ScrollMarks.description: Shows where things are in the whole document, in a bar next to the vertical scrollbar: every occurrence of the selected text, bookmarks, change history, find marks, style tokens and the caret. Markers line up with the scrollbar thumb. Click a marker to look there, hover it to preview the lines around it. Previous and next occurrence commands. Defaults follow the Notepad++ settings and theme. English and Korean.
ScrollMarks.author: Hong-Seungmin

SecurePad.description: Encrypt/decrypt whole documents or selected text with your own key. Useful for storing sensitive information like logins that you don't want lying around in a plaintext file.
SecurePad.author: Dominic Tobias

selectNLaunch.description: Get the selected text, save it as file with the extension you customized in the system temporary directory, then call system to open it with the extension-associated program.
selectNLaunch.author: Don HO

SelectQuotedText.description: Select the text in quotes (aka a string) based on the Scintilla lexers in Notepad++. Just press Alt+' and select the entire string under the cursor. If no string is found, it selects the current word.
SelectQuotedText.author: Frank Fesevur

SessionMgr.description: Session manager. IMPORTANT: If you are upgrading from a version older than 1.2 then, immediately after the upgrade, open the Settings dialog and reconfigure your settings.
SessionMgr.author: Mike Foster

SimplifyJson.description: SimplifyJson provides practical JSON tools for Notepad++: escape and unescape JSON strings, beautify JSON with readable indentation, and minify JSON by removing unnecessary whitespace. Commands operate on the selected text or the entire document and validate JSON before formatting.
SimplifyJson.author: Vipul Patil

SqlColumnHighlighter.description: Click a column name in a SQL INSERT statement to highlight its value(s); double-click a value to highlight its column. All rows are highlighted for multi-row INSERTs.
SqlColumnHighlighter.author: zhgao

SurroundSelection.description: Automatically surround the selection in quotes/brackets/parenthesis/etc.
SurroundSelection.author: Justin Dailey

TCSyslogFinder.description: Instantly find and open the latest Teamcenter syslog in Notepad++.
TCSyslogFinder.author: bsagarzazu

TidyText.description: Highlights and repairs non-printing and mis-encoded (mojibake) characters, including curly quotes, dashes, NBSP, zero-width spaces, BOM, and UTF-8-as-Latin-1 corruption. Also sends the current selection to ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini via the clipboard and your default browser.
TidyText.author: gonzalu

urlPlugin.description:
Hopefully a decent URL Encoder and Decoder plug-in for Notepad++ which helps to make developer's life easier by providing facility to encode/decode the URL within Notepad++. 

How it works:
1. Configure setting from menu (Plugins->URL Plugin->URL Plugin Settings). It is not mandatory, but recommended.
2. Select text/URL which you want to encode/decode.
3. Perform your task via Plugins->URL Plugin->Encode/Decode URL.
urlPlugin.author: Rajendra Singh

VSCodeKeymapNpp.description:
Ports the stock Windows VS Code shortcuts to Notepad++ as far as Notepad++ can reasonably follow them.
Maps clean Notepad++ or Scintilla equivalents, blocks conflicting fallthrough in strict mode, and keeps the rest documented in the coverage report.
VSCodeKeymapNpp.author: philip

XBrackets.description:
Allows autocompletion of brackets ([{""}])
Inserts corresponding right bracket when the left bracket is typed. Uses "smart" autocompletion: * next character is analysed for ([{ brackets; * next & previous characters are analysed for " quote.
Supports user-defined pairs of brackets/quotes.
XBrackets.author: Vitaliy Dovgan
